definitions.all_defined_growth_f1: 2TP/(2TP+FP+FN); both-empty pairs undefined; includes zero-actual-growth false positives
definitions.averaging: pair metric means within incident, then macro across defined incidents
definitions.conditional_growth_dice: same formula but only actual-growth-positive pairs, matching primary IoU population
definitions.full_footprint: all valid observed target cells, including already known footprint

selection: threshold chosen on validation only; primary remains 0.5; no new model inference or fitting

growth_only.f1_population: all pairs where actual or predicted growth is nonempty; no-growth false positives remain as F1=0

primary_new_growth.population: same actual-growth-positive pairs at every threshold; conditional Dice is not the all-defined growth F1
